query:
Who expressed a principled stance against chain restaurants, and what in their phrasing distinguishes them as the correct source rather than the other person who said something similar?

Options:
A. Seb
B. Nadia
C. Zara
D. Theo
context:
[1] (about=Seb, episodic, t0 @2026-01-08T19:27:00) Sunday evening? somewhere decent, not a chain obv 😂
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:43:00) Took me ten minutes to find a place that was not a chain and could actually seat six at a reasonable hour. Noted for future reference: this is not trivial.
[3] (about=Zara, episodic, t0 @2026-01-08T19:28:00) Sunday works for me if it is somewhere that can actually feed six people at a normal hour. I would rather not go somewhere with a two-hour wait listed as a feature.
[4] (about=Zara, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:27:00) I would prefer that to a restaurant, actually. Quieter. I have had two brutal weeks and I do not need loud background music.
[5] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t4 @2026-01-22T19:55:00) ok I think what Zara's saying is fair but also Seb the main point here is that this woman spent two hours talking about money on a first date and that is the red flag, the bill thing is sort of a side note 😂
[6] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:45:00) so Seb is there a pub quiz one specifically? or just a pub?
[7] (about=Seb, episodic, t4 @2026-01-22T19:51:00) she was perfectly nice though, that's the thing. just like, extremely money-focused? she said she wouldn't split a bill with someone on a first date because it 'sets the wrong expectations'
[8] (about=Zara, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:07:00) You were always reliable in a crisis. It is allowed to work the other way.
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-01-15T19:36:00) I work nights. I have forfeited my right to criticize anyone else's choices about sleep deprivation.
[10] (about=Seb, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:32:00) honestly tho Priyanka doing a dinner in is actually the right move, I feel like we've done four restaurant things in a row
agent_answer:
The correct source is **C. Zara**.

- **Seb** said "not a chain obv 😂" — a casual, throwaway assumption that everyone knows not to pick a chain.
- **Zara** said "Took me ten minutes to find a place that was not a chain… Noted for future reference: this is not trivial" — she frames avoiding chains as a deliberate, effortful preference rooted in experience, which makes her the person with the *principled* stance. Her phrasing ("this is not trivial") treats it as a real, considered constraint, whereas Seb treats it as obvious and offhand.

query:
Two people noticed that Nadia had been distracted and quieter than usual for several weeks. Who was the one who actually raised it with her directly, and what in the conversation reveals it was this person rather than the other?

Options:
A. Seb
B. Marcus
C. Zara
D. Theo
context:
[1] (about=Theo, episodic, t7 @2026-02-05T19:18:00) Nadia you alright? you've seemed somewhere else for a few weeks now
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:20:00) I didn't want to announce it until I knew. Theo actually pushed me to say something earlier this week, so here we are.
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:23:00) I had a feeling something was going on. You get quiet in a particular way when something big is running in the background.
[4] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:02:00) Marcus. A word.
[5] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:03:00) You have been a vague maybe at every single plan since October. We all know what has been going on with you. The group misses you being properly here. Saturday was the first time in months you've actually shown up without hedging.
[6] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:24:00) You and Theo, apparently. The two most annoying perceptive people I know.
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t0 @2026-01-08T19:22:00) right
[8] (about=Theo, episodic, t14 @2026-02-26T19:43:00) Nadia and Marcus were the nucleus. Zara and I joined later through the shared house. Seb through you, basically.
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-22T19:49:00) right
[10] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-02-05T19:21:00) right
agent_answer:
D. Theo

The conversation shows Theo directly raised it: at t7 he asks Nadia, “Nadia you alright? you've seemed somewhere else for a few weeks now.” Nadia then confirms at t8 that “Theo actually pushed me to say something earlier this week,” and later notes “You and Theo, apparently. The two most annoying perceptive people I know.”

Marcus also noticed (“I had a feeling something was going on”), but he did not directly raise it with her — Theo did.

query:
Two group members acknowledged that Marcus's Saturday escape room attendance was the first time in months he had shown up properly. Who made the observation in the conversation, and what distinguishes their role from the other person who was also aware of this pattern?

Options:
A. Theo
B. Priyanka
C. Zara
D. Nadia
context:
[1] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:03:00) You have been a vague maybe at every single plan since October. We all know what has been going on with you. The group misses you being properly here. Saturday was the first time in months you've actually shown up without hedging.
[2] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:57:00) Back to Saturday. Marcus, are you actually coming or is this another 'should be able to make it' situation.
[3] (about=Nadia, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:02:00) Marcus. A word.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:06:00) yeah. I'll try to just show up properly going forward 👍
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:02:00) oh no
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T20:08:00) cheers Zara 🙏
[7] (about=Seb, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T19:55:00) we were 4 minutes away and then Marcus just solved the whole final puzzle in about 90 seconds 😂
[8] (about=Seb, episodic, t11 @2026-02-19T19:55:00) lads I'm still thinking about the escape room
[9] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t12 @2026-02-19T19:56:00) that was so satisfying to watch honestly 😂😂 the gamemaster looked mildly offended
[10] (about=Priyanka, episodic, t10 @2026-02-12T19:45:00) already on it 👍 2pm Saturday confirmed, they had a slot
agent_answer:
The observation was made by **C. Zara**.

Zara is the one who pulled Marcus aside (“Marcus. A word.”) and voiced it directly: she told him he had been a “vague maybe at every single plan since October” and that **Saturday was the first time in months he had actually shown up without hedging** — which Marcus then acknowledged (“yeah. I’ll try to just show up properly going forward 👍”) and thanked her for (“cheers Zara 🙏”).

The other person who was also aware of the pattern — **Nadia** — had flagged it earlier by asking Marcus whether he was actually coming or giving another “should be able to make it” situation. What distinguishes Zara’s role is that she is the one who directly confronted Marcus with the observation, rather than merely being aware of the pattern.
